top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock rests on a distinct idea, magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms in a Lamb-Dicke lattice, not covered by the 2005 comb or 2012 single-quantum-system prizes. It has been verified by agreement between independently built Sr and Yb clocks at the 1e-18 level, and the two names map cleanly onto Katori's proposal and first realization and Ye's record accuracy and many-body work. P002 is a mature, well-confirmed concept but has an incomplete credit chain (Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang, 3D theory); P003 is younger with an unsettled mechanism and less clean credit, yet both still beat no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my documented connections (PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGOLite/PoGO+, XL-Calibur, KTH astroparticle) do not involve any proposed laureate, though as an instrument builder I favour clock-to-clock verification.
